text: Thus, the qualities of insentient matter operate in the form of the eleven senses. Even the specializations are created by them, by which the eye is situated in the upper region for the purpose of seeing, and similarly the nose, the ear, and the tongue are situated in their respective locations to perceive their own objects. Likewise, the organs of action are also respectively capable of their own functions and situated in their own places by their own nature, solely due to the specific transformation of qualities, and not [intentionally] for that purpose, as has been stated in other scriptures.
